custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin who can switch between two locations, the test location and location B, so a part can be stocked at location B only.
  • Create a part for this test at location B only, part A, with a category, category A, so part A is not stocked at the test location.
  • Use a different category, category B, from the Category list.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Location B is Staging Lethbridge - 4310. To switch: click the box at the top right, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Lethbridge - 4310. Switch back to Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 the same way.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425673-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425673-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Inventory Part window opens.

Step 2:

  • Description holds the text.

Step 3:

  • Part Number reads part A's part number.

Step 4:

  • Category reads category B.

Step 5:

  • Cost reads $10.00.

Step 6:

  • The window closes and the part is saved.

Step 7:

  • The Part Library page opens.

Step 8:

  • Part A's entry still shows category A, not category B.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description)

  • S7-R6c: “A linked entry with no category takes the one picked in the dialog. An entry that already has a category keeps it.”

From: Jira tickets and comments under epic SV-10647 (saved in sources/jira-2026-10-27/ALL-TICKETS-2026-10-27.md), read 27 Oct 2026

  • SV-10820, Chris Ward, 23 Oct 2026: “Please switch to B. When the typed number links to a Part Library entry that has no category, the entry takes the category picked in the dialog, the same way a missing manufacturer is filled (S7-R6b). If the entry already has a category, it keeps its own (S7-R6c).”
